basic_details.job_title: Ministry of Steel Young Professional Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Ministry of Steel, Government of India (Establishment-II & RTI Division), is engaging Young Professionals purely on contract basis for a consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000, inclusive of all applicable taxes. There are 6 tentative posts across five streams, each needing 1 year of relevant experience. Candidates fill the online form at serviceonline.gov.in and email the signed form and certificates to [email protected] so that the application is complete by 17 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Fill the online application form available on the website of M/o Steel at https://serviceonline.gov.in/directApply.do?serviceId=3348.

Prepare the duly filled and self-attested application form, all self-attested certificates as uploaded in the online application, and a copy of a valid photo ID proof (Aadhar/ PAN/ Voter ID/ other Government issued Photo-ID card).
Write the subject line of the mail strictly as: "Applicant Name_Application Reference Number_YP_Stream".
Make sure the application is complete in all respects by 17 December 2026.

The notice states this is the only permitted mode to apply, and applications submitted by any other mode will not be accepted. For queries or assistance, the office can be contacted at [email protected] or on 011-24155792.
important_instructions: Applications received after the last date are summarily rejected. Candidature is considered on the basis of the information declared in the application and the documents submitted at the interview. If any information is found false or incorrect, or the Ministry finds the candidate does not satisfy the eligibility criteria, candidature or engagement is liable to be cancelled or terminated. The decisions of the Screening Committee and the Selection Committee are final and binding; no queries will be entertained. Police verification will be done as per the latest MHA instructions; an adverse report ends the contract immediately without notice. The Ministry may require a Statement of Good Health from a recognized physician before work starts. A Young Professional has the legal status of an independent Consultant and is not a "staff member" or "official" of the Ministry; no employer-employee relationship is created. Either side can terminate the contract: the Ministry may do so at any time without assigning reasons, normally giving one month's notice, and the Young Professional may do so on one month's notice. A minimum of three days' induction training may be organized after joining, not counted as remunerated service unless the Ministry decides otherwise. The Young Professional is solely responsible for his or her own insurance and is subject to the Indian Official Secrets Act, 1923.

rows.details: Ministry of Steel, Government of India (Establishment-II & RTI Division)
Young Professionals (Mining/ Metallurgy/ Geology; International Relations; Finance/ Accounts; Legal; Information Technology)
Fixed period of two years, extendable up to a maximum of five years
Consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000/- (inclusive of all applicable taxes; no other facility or allowance)
Online form, plus email of the signed form and certificates

content_sections.heading: About the Ministry of Steel Young Professionals Engagement
content_sections.text: The Ministry of Steel is a Government of India ministry whose Establishment-II & RTI Division is located at Netaji Nagar, New Delhi. It describes this engagement as recruitment of Young Professionals purely on contract basis, to provide services on specific projects as per the requirements of its Verticals/Divisions. The notice is dated 26/11/2026.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 6 posts in total, and states that the number of posts is tentative. The actual number to be engaged will be decided as per requirements at the time of selection.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each stream has its own essential qualification and essential work experience. The notice says candidates must be below 32 years of age as on 26/11/2026. Expertise in steel-making, raw materials, Mineral policy production/supply analysis/ Beneficiation, Mining/ Steel Sector Policy, Steel Trade Analysis, Data Analysis, with proficiency in MS Excel and Powerpoint. Expertise in drafting of briefs and background papers on international engagements; coordination with multilateral/bilateral bodies; assistance in facilitation of meetings with foreign dignitaries; research and analysis on global steel sector trends and policies; strong English communication and coordination skills; with proficiency in MS Office applications. Expertise in analysis of accounts; financial proposals, basic data analysis and proficiency in MS Office applications. LLM from a recognized University/ Institute. Expertise in AI/ML concepts and applications; data management, analytics, visualization and dashboard-based monitoring; web applications, APIs, cloud and enterprise applications; ability to assess technology solutions; awareness of cybersecurity risks in IT/OT environments; formulate problem statements and monitor implementation; and coordinate with CPSES, NIC, technology providers, startups and technical agencies. Candidates with M.Phil., M.Tech. MBA, M.S., MCA, LLM, Ph.D, additional qualifications, research experience, published papers and post qualification experience in the relevant field would be preferred. Information Technology: experience in implementation or management of IT/e-Governance projects, cybersecurity, Government websites and portals, cloud infrastructure, data analytics or digital transformation initiatives projects. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B.Tech. in Mining/ Mineral/ Metallurgical Engineering/ Material Science or Master's in Geology/ Mineral Economics or related field.
rows.essential_work_experience: 1 year of experience in mining/metallurgy/geology sector/ Steel Sector/ Mineral sector.

rows.essential_qualification: MA in Political Science/ International Relations/ International Affairs/ Economics.
rows.essential_work_experience: 1 year of experience in International cooperation, bilateral and multilateral engagement, foreign affairs, trade related work.

rows.essential_qualification: Master's Degree in Accounts/ Finance/ Commerce or CA/CS.
rows.essential_work_experience: 1 year of experience in the field of finance/ accounts.

rows.essential_qualification: LLB from a recognized University/ Institute.
rows.essential_work_experience: 1 year of post-qualification experience in the legal field.

rows.essential_qualification: B.E./B Tech. or Master's Degree in Computer Science / Information Technology / Data Science / Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning / Information Systems/ Electronics & Communication or Master's Degree in Computer Applications from a recognized University/ Institute.
rows.essential_work_experience: 1 year of post-qualification experience in e-Governance, IT Systems, Enterprise Applications, Data Analytics & Visualization, Web Applications, Digital Platforms, Cloud/Emerging Technologies and technology-enabled process improvement/ Cybersecurity.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Young Professionals receive a consolidated remuneration of ₹70,000/-, inclusive of all applicable taxes. No other facility or allowance is allowed. Payment is released within one week after the month ends, based on biometric attendance or certification by the officer concerned if the Young Professional is deputed elsewhere. Tenure: fixed two years, which may be extended by three additional years on an annual basis (2 + 1 + 1 + 1), up to a maximum of five years. Continuation depends on a satisfactory Annual Performance Review and the Ministry's requirements, based on Key Performance Indicators. Remuneration review: if the contract exceeds one year, remuneration may be reviewed annually. Routine or assigned work earns Nil enhancement; significant contribution and exceptional quality up to 5%; exemplary performance with significant contribution to policymaking, published articles or authored books up to 10%. Total annual enhancement shall not exceed 10% in any year, and remuneration shall in no case exceed 1.35 times the initial remuneration. Domestic tours (with competent authority approval): air in Economy Class or rail in AC Two-Tier; hotel up to Rs.2,250/- per day; taxi up to Rs.338/- per day within the city; food up to Rs.900/- per day. Leave: 1.5 days for each complete month, no accumulation beyond a calendar year, pro-rata. Absence up to one month may be considered without remuneration with the approval of Secretary (Steel). Taxes: income tax or other taxes are deducted at source and a TDS certificate is issued. GST, as applicable, is admissible to the Young Professionals.

content_sections.heading: Ministry of Steel Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Should preferably possess expertise in raw material demand and supply analysis, mining policy, mineral exploration and beneficiation, monitoring of mining projects and associated environmental and forest clearances, transport logistics, infrastructure planning, and GIS-based mapping under PM Gati Shakti. Provide analytical inputs on international trade and undertake country-wise steel trade analysis. Identify and share export opportunities in existing and emerging markets with industry; assess tariff and non-tariff barriers affecting steel exports. Explore opportunities for steel import substitution, support online export promotion campaigns, technical/sectoral analysis/ case study and review various portals. Proficiency in data analysis, policy research, report writing and stakeholder coordination would be desirable. The engagement would facilitate timely examination of policy proposals, consolidation of stakeholder inputs, preparation of briefs and reports, and follow-up with CPSEs and other Ministries on pending matters. Provide technical and professional support on IT, e-Governance, cybersecurity, IT infrastructure management and digital transformation in the Ministry of Steel. Assist in development, implementation and monitoring of IT systems, web applications and digital initiatives, including compliance with GIGW, DBIM and applicable cybersecurity guidelines. Coordinate with NIC, CPSEs and other stakeholders on website management, security audits, VAPT, disaster recovery and cloud services. Support implementation and monitoring of industrial digitalisation initiatives involving AI, ML, IoT, Industry 4.0, industrial automation, Operational Technology (OT), IT/OT integration, predictive maintenance, digital twins and manufacturing analytics. Assist in preparation of technical reports, policy frameworks, project proposals, progress reviews and capacity-building programmes in the Ministry and its CPSEs. Render expert views on all financial matters of the Ministry/CPSEs under Ministry of Steel, relating to examination of their financial statements. Advise on improving their financial health as per guidelines issued by DPE, DIPAM, Ministry of Finance, etc., in accordance with the Companies Act. May also be required to examine financial proposals of the Ministry/CPSEs referred to the Ministry, including public procurement related issues. Provide expert opinion and advisory services on WTO issues, trade remedial measures and international trade matters, including the Global Forum on Steel Excess Capacity (GFSEC) under OECD. Handle legal matters of the Ministry/CPSEs referred to the Ministry and give legal advice to resolve legal issues/cases in consultation with the Department of Legal Affairs, Central Government Standing Counsels, CPSEs, etc. Should be conversant with international trade law. content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Ministry of Steel Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Fill the online application form available on the website of M/o Steel at https://serviceonline.gov.in/directApply.do?serviceId=3348 . Prepare the duly filled and self-attested application form, all self-attested certificates as uploaded in the online application, and a copy of a valid photo ID proof (Aadhar/ PAN/ Voter ID/ other Government issued Photo-ID card). Email these documents to [email protected] . Write the subject line of the mail strictly as: "Applicant Name_Application Reference Number_YP_Stream". Make sure the application is complete in all respects by 17 December 2026. The notice states this is the only permitted mode to apply, and applications submitted by any other mode will not be accepted. For queries or assistance, the office can be contacted at [email protected] or on 011-24155792.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications received within the stipulated time are scrutinized and shortlisted by a Screening Committee. Shortlisted applicants are invited for interview before a Selection Committee, and candidates numbering about 10 times the vacancies in each post will be invited. The Selection Committee may devise its own method for selecting suitable candidates and may recommend a panel of names for a reserve list valid for one year from the date of recommendation. The notice does not mention an interview date or venue. Shortlisted candidates must carry original documents to the interview. Requisite documents, in original and self-attested photocopies, supporting eligibility and identity must be produced at the interview for verification; otherwise the candidate may not be permitted to appear. No TA/DA will be provided for attending the interview. Only candidates who are selected for the program shall be intimated.
